**Coaching note:**

White's queen on f7 and the e5 pawn create a mating trap. By capturing with check (fxe5+), you force Black's king to take the pawn—the only legal move. Then Qf4 is checkmate; the king on e5 has no escape. The key insight: a forcing check that sacrifices material can lead to mate faster than slow captures. When you spot a check that pulls the king forward, calculate the follow-up before retreating to safety.
